'''Tempo of Infinity''' is a work of art from the [[Age of Legends]], created by [[Ceran Tol]]. The exact nature of the object is not described in detail, but it is mentioned while [[Graendal]] observes artworks on a wall, so perhaps it is a painting of some kind.{{ref/book|6|23}}

The last known location of the object is a room in the apartments that [[Sammael]] used in [[Illian]] while he was disguised as Lord Brend.

Sammael claims to have found the artwork in a [[stasis box]].
